caption: The drawing depicts a round, metal grill grate with a series of evenly spaced parallel bars running across its diameter, enclosed by a circular outer ring. The grill is elevated by three short, straight legs attached to the circular ring, giving it a tripod-like stance for stability. Extending from one side of the grill's circumference, there is a straight, elongated handle with a square-shaped hole near the end, suggesting it could be used to lift or maneuver the grill. The drawing is created using gray pencil or graphite on an off-white background, which brings out the metallic appearance of the object without the use of color. The lines used to depict the grill are slightly uneven, adding texture and dimension to the representation of the metal bars. The composition centers the object on the page, with the handle oriented towards the upper left corner and the legs pointing downwards.
title: Warmer
